envVars.description: serve-http only: HMAC key for signed upload handles. Only needed when running more than one instance, so a handle issued by one verifies on another.

envVars.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator to send on authorize/token/refresh requests. Opt-in until the Gency authorization server is confirmed to accept it.

name: aliasunder/vault-cortex
description: Standalone Obsidian vault server: hybrid search, notes and files, memory and tasks; run locally or self-host for remote access.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for MCP client authentication. Must match the Authorization header sent by clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

envVars.name: PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Public URL clients use to reach this server. Used as the OAuth issuer URL in discovery metadata. Override when exposing the server outside localhost or on a non-default port.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the embedding pipeline. When false, no ONNX model is downloaded, no vector tables are created, and search uses FTS5 only.

envVars.name: RERANK_MODE
envVars.description: Cross-encoder reranking mode: blended (position-aware score blending after RRF fusion) or none (skip reranking). Only takes effect when EMBEDDING_ENABLED is true.

envVars.name: WINDOWS_MODE
envVars.description: Windows bind-mount mode: enables filesystem polling for the file watcher and rename-based moves across the Docker Desktop/WSL2 bridge. Set to true when the vault lives on a Windows drive.

envVars.name: MEMORY_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable the structured memory layer. When false, memory tools are hidden, bootstrap is skipped, and server metadata omits memory references.

envVars.name: FILE_TOOLS_ENABLED
envVars.description: Enable or disable file tools (vault_read_file, vault_list_files). When false, file tools are hidden and server metadata omits file tool references.

envVars.name: READONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Run the server read-only: every vault-writing tool is hidden, the memory folder is not auto-created, and server metadata omits write references.

envVars.name: DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Hide individual tools by name, comma-separated. Subtractive only — it cannot re-enable a tool another setting hides; an unknown tool name stops the server at startup.

envVars.name: MEMORY_DIR
envVars.description: Vault folder for structured memory files (About Me-style notes). Memory tools are hidden when MEMORY_ENABLED is false, but this value still feeds the defaults for PROTECTED_PATHS and ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS.

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Vault folder for daily notes. Overrides the folder configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "Daily Notes".

envVars.name: DAILY_NOTES_FORMAT
envVars.description: Filename date format for daily notes (Moment.js tokens). Overrides the format configured in Obsidian's daily-notes plugin. When unset, read from the vault's .obsidian/daily-notes.json, falling back to "YYYY-MM-DD".

envVars.name: TRUST_PROXY_HOPS
envVars.description: Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops used to derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. With 0, injected forwarding headers are ignored.

envVars.name: TRUST_FORWARDED_HOPS
envVars.description: How many entries from the end of the RFC 7239 Forwarded header's for= list to count to reach the client IP for OAuth rate limiting and request logs. 0 ignores the header; 1 when the proxy in front writes it (e.g. AWS API Gateway); 2 when a CDN fronts that proxy and is the only way to reach it.

envVars.name: TZ
envVars.description: IANA timezone for timestamps and daily note resolution.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging verbosity.

envVars.name: LOG_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for log files that survive container re-creation. The container's own log is always written but discarded when the container is recreated; date-stamped files under LOG_DIR persist on the data volume. Default: /data/logs (remote image), $STORAGE_ROOT/data/logs (single-volume mode), none (local image). none keeps only the container log.

envVars.name: LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
envVars.description: Days to keep log files before automatic cleanup on startup; only applies when LOG_DIR is a path.

envVars.name: PROTECTED_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names blocked from vault_delete_note and vault_move_note. Default: MEMORY_DIR plus the daily notes folder, read from DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER or .obsidian/daily-notes.json (default Daily Notes). When set, overrides the default entirely.

envVars.name: ORPHAN_EXCLUDE_FOLDERS
envVars.description: Comma-separated vault folder names excluded from vault_find_orphans. Default: DAILY_NOTES_FOLDER (else "Daily Notes"), "Templates", MEMORY_DIR.

envVars.name: SERVICE_DOCUMENTATION_URL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth service documentation URL exposed via discovery metadata.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest file vault_read_file will read, in bytes. Reading a larger file returns an error instead of content.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for images returned by vault_read_file, in binary bytes before base64 encoding. Images exceeding the budget are downscaled/recompressed server-side to fit; raise for clients that accept larger tool responses.

envVars.name: MAX_PDF_RENDER_PAGES
envVars.description: Maximum PDF pages to render as images when raw: true is set on vault_read_file. The per-page byte budget is MAX_IMAGE_OUTPUT_BYTES divided evenly across the rendered pages.

envVars.description: Keystore password inline. Prefer ZERODUST_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD_FILE.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing a hex private key, so the key stays out of the MCP config.

envVars.name: ZERODUST_PRIVATE_KEY

envVars.name: DATABASE_URL
envVars.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

envVars.name: PG_HOST
envVars.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

envVars.name: PG_PORT
envVars.description: Database port.

envVars.name: PG_USER
envVars.description: Database user.

envVars.name: PG_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Database password.

envVars.name: PG_DATABASE
envVars.description: Database name.

envVars.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
envVars.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

envVars.name: PG_SSLMODE
envVars.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a server without TLS needs disable.

envVars.name: PG_SSL_CA
envVars.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

envVars.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
envVars.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

envVars.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

envVars.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

envVars.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_HOST
envVars.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PORT
envVars.description: SSH bastion port.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_USER
envVars.description: SSH username.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
envVars.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
envVars.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
envVars.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

envVars.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
envVars.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.

envVars.description: Embedding backend for pattern retrieval: tei, openai, ollama, vllm or hosted_vllm.

envVars.name: EMBEDDER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Required: the dense retrieval leg embeds the 40-pattern catalogue during startup warmup and the server refuses to start when the endpoint is unreachable. OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint ending in /v1: on the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080/v1 (add --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway on Linux); on a shared Docker network use http://pattern-tei-embed:8080/v1.

envVars.name: EMBEDDER_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the embedder. Keyless TEI accepts any non-empty value; use 'not-needed' there.

envVars.name: RERANKER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Required: pattern retrieval runs a mandatory TEI cross-encoder rerank. On the Docker host use http://host.docker.internal:8080; on a shared Docker network use http://pattern-tei-rerank:8080.

envVars.description: Static bearer token clients present as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Required only when MCP_AUTH_MODE=static-key.

envVars.description: HMAC key (at least 32 bytes) sealing the approval-gated write tools' requestState on MCP 2026-07-28 connections (#1031). Optional: unset uses a random per-process key, which is fine for a single replica; set the same value on every replica of a multi-replica deployment.

envVars.name: MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY_PREVIOUS
envVars.description: Second requestState HMAC key, accepted for opening a sealed plan but never for sealing one: two-key rotation of MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY (#1032). Optional, and only valid together with MCP_REQUEST_STATE_KEY. When rolling the key across replicas set this to the old key, and remove it two minutes after the last replica restarted.

envVars.name: MCP_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 public key (base64url) that MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key verifies license tokens against. DEFAULTS TO A SHARED DEMO KEY, which authenticates a token holder rather than a customer — every BlueCat-issued token for this server verifies against it. For anything beyond a trial, generate a per-deployment key pair (license-keygen --gen-key) and set this to its public half.

envVars.name: MCP_SIGNED_KEY_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: When set, a license token must carry exactly this audience or it is rejected — a declarative scope check on top of the key, so a token minted for another deployment fails even if it verifies. Unset means the aud claim is not checked. Only meaningful with MCP_AUTH_MODE=signed-key.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
envVars.description: Token issuer URL, matched against the iss claim of incoming JWTs. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint whose public keys verify the signature on every incoming Bearer JWT. Required when MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server — the server refuses to start in that mode without it.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT aud claim for MCP_AUTH_MODE=resource-server. A token carrying a different audience, or no aud claim at all, is rejected. Unset skips audience validation entirely.

envVars.name: ACCEPT_EULA

envVars.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: recall/search/list_memories/engram/stats/revisions only, no write or delete tools.

envVars.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

envVars.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

envVars.name: LOADER_PATH
envVars.description: Directory Spring Boot's PropertiesLauncher scans for extension jars; already set to /app/adapters by the image, but startup still fails with MISSING_SOURCE_ADAPTER until you bind-mount a reviewed DataSourceAdapter/IdentityResolver jar there (see the -v arguments above)

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: OAuth2/OIDC issuer that mints the caller's JWT; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT audience claim for this deployment; required for every protected deployment

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS location used to verify caller JWTs; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI is required, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_ISSUER_DISCOVERY_URI
envVars.description: Alternative HTTPS OIDC issuer-discovery location; set this instead of DATAPRISM_SECURITY_JWT_JWK_SET_URI, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_PRINCIPAL
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's principal identifier; required, must differ from the roles and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_ROLES
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the caller's roles; required, must differ from the principal and investigation claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_CALLER_CLAIMS_INVESTIGATION
envVars.description: JWT claim name that carries the trusted investigation/case identifier; required, must differ from the principal and roles claims

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITY_POLICY_PURPOSES
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of permitted purposes; at least one is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_INVESTIGATOR
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SECURITYPOLICY_ROLES_<ROLE> per operator-defined role (no underscore between SECURITY and POLICY: Spring Boot's map-key enumeration under a hyphenated dataprism.security-policy.roles.<role> segment only binds the concatenated prefix, verified by binding this property directly against Spring Boot 3.5.16), a comma-separated list of known MCP tool capabilities; at least one role-to-capability mapping is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_PROFILE
envVars.description: Name of the reviewed privacy profile implementation to apply; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_SCOPE_LIFETIME
envVars.description: Positive duration (e.g. 8h) a privacy scope's synthetic identities remain valid; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Identifier of the pinned HMAC key used to derive synthetic identities; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE
envVars.description: Name of the environment variable holding the HMAC key material; exactly one of this or DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE is required, never both, and never a literal key value

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_PROVIDER_REFERENCE
envVars.description: Reference to an approved secret provider holding the HMAC key material; set this instead of DATAPRISM_PRIVACY_HMAC_KEY_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, never both

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit sink implementation: one of approved-sink, slf4j, hash-chained; required, never downgraded to no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_WRITER_ID
envVars.description: Writer/instance identity recorded on every audit entry; required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_AUDIT_FILE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the durable, hash-chained audit log; required when DATAPRISM_AUDIT_SINK=hash-chained, refused as MISSING_AUDIT_FILE_PATH if absent for that sink, ignored otherwise

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_METRICS_SINK
envVars.description: Metrics sink binding, currently only micrometer; required in production, never the framework no-op

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_HAZELCAST_TOPOLOGY
envVars.description: Cluster read-budget topology: embedded (shared across the cluster) or single-node (enforced per process); required, never defaulted

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_BASE_URL (HTTPS) per configured source; at least one source, each with its own reviewed DataSourceAdapter bean, is required

envVars.name: DATAPRISM_SOURCES_CUSTOMER_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Example only — declare DATAPRISM_SOURCES_<NAME>_TIMEOUT (positive duration) per configured source; required alongside its base URL

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE
envVars.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD
envVars.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_MARK
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL
envVars.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT
envVars.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.

envVars.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
envVars.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_KV_STORE_URL
envVars.description: Persistent-state backend URL shared by every pvl-core subsystem that needs state. `memory://` is in-process and lost on restart; `file:///path` persists on one server; `redis://`, `dynamodb://` and `mongodb://` each need their matching extra. When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` — with a warning — on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names this instance exposes; every other tool is hidden from listings and cannot be invoked. Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_deny`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TOOLS_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated explicit tool names hidden from this instance (absent from listings, cannot be invoked). Names matching no registered tool are inert. Mutually exclusive with `tools_allow`. Takes effect through `apply_tool_visibility`.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SERVER_NAME
envVars.description: Rename this server instance; defaults to the project name.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Replaces the default MCP instructions text sent to clients.

envVars.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Log level for FastMCP internals and app loggers (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR / CRITICAL). The -v CLI flag overrides to DEBUG.

envVars.name: FASTMCP_ENABLE_RICH_LOGGING
envVars.description: Set false for plain or structured JSON log output.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_HOST; logs a warning when used.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_A1111_MODEL
envVars.description: Deprecated alias for IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SD_WEBUI_MODEL; logs a warning when used.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When true, write-tagged tools (image generation, transforms, uploads) are hidden from clients. Set false to enable them.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_SCRATCH_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where generated images are saved. Created automatically on first use.

envVars.description: Comma-separated provider names that cost money; generate_image asks for confirmation (client elicitation) before using them. An empty value falls back to this default; to disable confirmation, set a value that names no provider (such as none).

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_STYLES_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for style preset files (Markdown with YAML front matter). Created automatically if it does not exist.

envVars.description: Allow reading input images from local filesystem paths. Off by default: only URLs and uploads are accepted.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_MAX_INPUT_IMAGE_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted input image size in bytes.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when fetching remote image URLs (fetch_image and URL inputs).

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: IMAGE_GENERATION_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES

envVars.name: FORMIO_PROJECT_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and the WEAKEST of the three project sources: a committed formio.json found by walking up from the working directory wins, then the per-directory mapping project_set writes, then this. It pins nothing — project_set can redirect a directory whose environment names a different project. Useful for a launch with nowhere to record a project, such as CI or a container (e.g. https://examples.form.io on the hosted cloud; self-hosted it is either https://your-project.your-domain.com or https://your-host/project-name, depending on how that deployment routes projects). Leave it unset and the agent asks for a project and records it per directory.

envVars.name: FORMIO_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Optional, and usually unnecessary: the base URL is DERIVED from the project URL — https://api.form.io for a project on a form.io host, the parent path for a project addressed as a sub-directory — and is asked for only when it cannot be derived, which is a path-less project URL on a customer domain. There is no default. Like FORMIO_PROJECT_URL it is the weakest source, behind a committed formio.json and the per-directory mapping.

envVars.name: FORMIO_API_KEY
envVars.description: Form.io project API key. Optional — when omitted the server uses a browser-based portal login flow to obtain a JWT.

envVars.name: FORMIO_LOGIN_FORM
envVars.description: URL of a custom login form used by the browser-based portal login flow. Defaults to the deployment's portal login form.

envVars.name: FORMIO_FORCE_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to 1 to attempt the browser login even where the server detects it cannot present one (CI, a container, a remote shell with no display). Use it when the login page is reachable from a browser elsewhere.

envVars.name: FORMIO_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification. For local development against self-signed certificates only — never enable in production.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY
envVars.description: Ed25519 seed, 64 hex characters, that signs this server's evidence-bundle receipts and checkpoint, so gateway_public_key (get_server_info) is the same after a restart and can be pinned. Set in your MCP client's configuration, the seed sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Receipts are kept in memory only; save a generate_evidence_bundle result before the server stops. Unset or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr. When set, even to an invalid value, AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE is not read.

envVars.name: AGA_GATEWAY_KEY_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file holding the 64-hex Ed25519 seed; read only when AGA_GATEWAY_KEY is unset or empty, with the same effect. A stdio server started by your MCP client runs as the client's OS user, so the file sits inside the governed client's trust domain. Missing, unreadable or invalid: a new key each start, warned on stderr.

description: Unofficial: Apple Music, iCloud Calendar/Contacts/Mail, Apple Maps and WeatherKit, no Mac needed

envVars.description: Your Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Needed for Apple Music (official API), Apple Maps and WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Key ID of a private key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys with Media Services (MusicKit), MapKit JS and/or WeatherKit enabled.

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Local installs only: a path to the .p8 file instead of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Music (pair with APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Music.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_MAPS_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for Apple Maps.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_KEY_ID
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_KEY_ID for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Optional per-service override of APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY for WeatherKit.

envVars.name: APPLE_WEATHERKIT_SERVICE_ID
envVars.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional: a pre-minted Apple Music developer token (JWT) instead of signing one from the key above.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_WEB_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Optional override for the web-player developer token (normally read automatically from music.apple.com).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
envVars.description: Two-letter Apple Music storefront (e.g. us, gb). Default: your account's storefront, else us.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_USERNAME
envVars.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

envVars.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_MAIL_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

envVars.name: ICLOUD_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
envVars.description: Calendar new events go to when none is named (default: the first writable event calendar).

envVars.name: APPLE_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.name: APPLE_SERVICES
envVars.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

envVars.name: DISPLAY_TZ
envVars.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

envVars.name: APPLE_UNITS
envVars.description: "metric" (default) or "imperial" units for weather (Maps distances always show both).

envVars.name: APPLE_STATE_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to write nothing under $MCP_DATA_DIR/.apple-icloud-mcp: no web-player token or iCloud discovery cache, and the rejected-password latch and spent confirmation tokens then last only as long as the process.

envVars.name: APPLE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: APPLE_DEBUG_LOG
envVars.description: Set to 1 to log every upstream request line to stderr (credentials redacted).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_MODE
envVars.description: How confirm-gated writes (send mail, deletes, removing tracks, invitations) behave on a client with no prompt, like claude.ai: "ask-user" (default: preview + confirmToken, the model must get your OK), "auto", or "refuse". Unknown values mean refuse.

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of a confirmToken in seconds (default 600).

envVars.name: MCP_CONFIRM_SECRET
envVars.description: Signing key for confirmTokens. Random per process by default; set it so a token issued just before a restart or redeploy still works (spent tokens are recorded on disk, so none can be replayed).

envVars.description: Write-tool gate: "none" registers no write tools; "drafts" registers draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments); "all" registers everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

envVars.description: Default "false". Whether ofw_sync_messages fetches unread inbox bodies by default (each fetch stamps a First Viewed time). Capped by OFW_ALLOW_MARK_READ.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_CACHE
envVars.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

envVars.name: OFW_SESSION_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

envVars.name: OFW_EXPENSE_ONLY
envVars.description: Set true to register only healthcheck plus expense tools. All profile/dashboard, message, calendar, and journal tools are structurally absent.

envVars.name: CCU_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

envVars.name: CCU_PASSWORD
envVars.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login). Must be set; the value may be empty for a CCU with no password

envVars.name: CCU_USER
envVars.description: CCU username

envVars.name: CCU_HTTPS
envVars.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

envVars.name: CCU_PORT
envVars.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

envVars.name: CCU_PROFILES
envVars.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

envVars.name: CCU_DEFAULT_PROFILE
envVars.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_VERIFY
envVars.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

envVars.name: CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT
envVars.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

envVars.name: CCU_CA_CERT
envVars.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

envVars.name: CCU_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

envVars.name: CACHE_TTL
envVars.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_BURST
envVars.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

envVars.name: CCU_RATE_LIMIT_RATE
envVars.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

envVars.name: RESOURCE_POLL_INTERVAL
envVars.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr

envVars.description: Local repo root for repo-backed tools and pipeline planning. Also readable from `repoPath` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.description: Base directory for the local data cache. When set, cache files are written here instead of the working directory. Also readable from `cacheDir` in the active ~/.coa/config profile.

envVars.description: JSON size threshold before auto-caching to disk. Defaults to 32768.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INLINE_RESPONSES
envVars.description: Forces large responses inline as text instead of auto-caching them to disk and returning a `resource_link` (and suppresses per-field cache resource links). The server already auto-enables this for clients known not to support MCP resources (e.g. Snowflake Cortex), which otherwise render the link as unreadable "binary data" and retry in a loop. Set `true` to force it on for an unrecognised client, or `false` to disable auto-detection. Leave unset for Claude/Cursor to keep large payloads out of context. Defaults to false (auto-enabled for resource-less clients).

envVars.description: In-memory lineage cache TTL in milliseconds. Defaults to 1800000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Default per-request timeout for Coalesce API calls. Raise on large workspaces where paginated reads exceed the default. Defaults to 60000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_DETAIL_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_TYPE_RANKING_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Deadline for the best-effort workspace-adoption node-type ranking lookup inside node creation. Advisory only — creation proceeds without a ranking suggestion if this trips. Defaults to 15000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_INVENTORY_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-type inventory. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_INDEX_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-index (id/name/type/location) cache used by SQL- and intent-ref resolution. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_NODE_DETAIL_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: In-memory TTL for the workspace node-detail (full body) cache used by review and predecessor lookups. Set to `0` to disable. Defaults to 300000.

envVars.name: COALESCE_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When `true`, hides all write/mutation tools during registration. Only read, list, search, cache, analyze, review, diagnose, and plan tools are exposed. Defaults to false.

description: Couchbase MCP Server - Enable AI agents to connect to and interact with Couchbase clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: Couchbase connection string. Required for connecting to the cluster.

envVars.name: CB_USERNAME
envVars.description: Couchbase database username. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Couchbase database password. Required for basic authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CA_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase CA certificate path. Required for TLS authentication in non Capella clusters.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_CERT_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client certificate path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_CLIENT_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Couchbase client key path. Required for mTLS authentication.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_READ_ONLY_MODE
envVars.description: Couchbase read only mode. Set to true to allow disable write operations across both KV and query. KV write tools are not loaded and SQL++ queries that modify data are blocked. Set to false to allow data modification queries and tools.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio, http or sse). Default is stdio

envVars.name: CB_MCP_HOST
envVars.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP and SSE transport modes.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Tools to disable. Accepts comma-separated tool names (e.g., 'tool_1,tool_2') or a file path containing one tool name per line.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Also accepts a file path containing one tool name per line. Requires the MCP client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level for the MCP server. One of off, debug, info, warning, error. Use 'off' to disable logging entirely. Invalid values fall back to info. Default is info.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of log destinations. Allowed values: stderr, file. Include 'file' to write per-level log files; include 'stderr' to write to the console. Default is stderr.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Base path for the per-level log files. One rotating file is written per level (e.g. mcp_server.info.log, mcp_server.error.log). Only used when 'file' is in CB_MCP_LOG_SINKS. Default is mcp_server.log.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Global maximum size in MB per-level log file before it rotates, inherited by every level unless overridden by a per-level CB_MCP_LOG_<LEVEL>_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default (1 MB) with a startup warning. Default is 1 (1 MB).

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: [DEPRECATED] Global rotation size in bytes; use CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB (MB) instead. Still honored for backward compatibility but ignored when CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB is also set. A value of 0 is invalid and falls back to the default with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for ERROR; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for WARNING; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for INFO; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Rotation size in MB for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_ROTATION_MAX_SIZE_MB for DEBUG; inherits it when unset. 0 is invalid and falls back to the inherited global with a startup warning.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Number of rotated backup files kept per-level log file, excluding the live file. Applies to every level unless overridden per level. Set to 0 to keep only the live file (still capped by the rotation size). Default is 1.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_ERROR_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the ERROR log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for ERROR; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_WARNING_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the WARNING log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for WARNING; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_INFO_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the INFO log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for INFO; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_LOG_DEBUG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT
envVars.description: Rotated backups kept for the DEBUG log file. Overrides CB_MCP_LOG_RETENTION_BACKUP_COUNT for DEBUG; inherits it when unset.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: JWKS endpoint of the identity provider used to verify bearer JWT signatures. Required to enable OAuth, along with CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER and CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE. Only honored when CB_MCP_TRANSPORT=http.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'iss' claim value. Also advertised as the authorization server in Protected Resource Metadata when CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL is set. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_AUDIENCE
envVars.description: Expected JWT 'aud' claim value. Required to enable OAuth.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_JWT_ALGORITHM
envVars.description: JWT signing algorithm. One of RS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, PS256/384/512. Default is RS256.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_MCP_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Public base URL of this MCP server. When set, the server publishes RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at <base_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp so PRM-aware clients can discover the authorization server. Optional.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'read' access; advertised in PRM and matched against the token's scope/scp claim. Use when your IdP cannot emit the canonical form. Default is couchbase-mcp:read.

envVars.name: CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_WRITE_LABEL
envVars.description: Override the OAuth scope label the server treats as 'write' access; same semantics as CB_MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_READ_LABEL. Default is couchbase-mcp:write.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Eurostat API base URL. Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_COMEXT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the Comext dissemination host, which serves every DS-* dataset code (detailed trade and PRODCOM). Override when using a mirror or proxy.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for Eurostat API calls.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_METADATA_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one dataset's SDMX dataflow structure, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because the structure carries a label for every code the dataset uses: 23 MB, uncompressed, for DS-045409. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_TOC_CACHE_TTL_MS
envVars.description: How long a fetched catalogue TOC stays usable before the next catalogue call refreshes it, in milliseconds. Defaults to 12 hours.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: HTTP timeout for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, in milliseconds. Held separate from EUROSTAT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS because a bulk body streams for minutes where a metadata call answers in seconds. Defaults to 2 minutes.

envVars.name: EUROSTAT_BULK_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte budget for one eurostat_download_dataset transfer, counted on the decoded TSV rather than on the wire. Eurostat sends the body chunked with no Content-Length, so the budget is enforced while streaming and the transfer is aborted when it is reached. Defaults to 50 MiB.

envVars.name: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE
envVars.description: Set to 'duckdb' to enable the dataframe canvas, which lists the eurostat_dataframe_describe and eurostat_dataframe_query tools, lets eurostat_query_dataset stage a match larger than its 5,000-row inline cap as a SQL table, and lets eurostat_download_dataset retain a whole bulk download instead of only its inline preview. The DuckDB binding ships with the server, so this variable is the only switch.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TEMP_PATH
envVars.description: Directory DuckDB writes canvas spill files to. Must be writable by the server process. Defaults to a 'mcp-canvas' directory under the OS temp directory.

envVars.name: CANVAS_TTL_MS
envVars.description: Sliding lifetime of a staged dataframe canvas in milliseconds; every call against it extends the window. Defaults to 24 hours.

envVars.name: CANVAS_DEFAULT_ROW_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum rows a single eurostat_dataframe_query returns before the result is reported as truncated.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_WATCH
envVars.description: Enable automatic file watcher to detect changes and re-index modified files (true/1 to enable). Useful during active development.

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Explicit HuggingFace endpoint URL to use for model downloads. When set, auto-mirror detection is skipped and this URL is used directly. Useful when you have a full-featured mirror.

envVars.name: HF_AUTO_MIRROR
envVars.description: Enable automatic mirror detection for HuggingFace downloads (defaults to true). Set to "false" or "0" to disable and use huggingface.co directly. The mirror chain is: huggingface.co → hf-mirror.com → modelscope.cn.

envVars.name: HTTPS_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTPS proxy URL for downloading embedding models (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Required only if behind a corporate proxy.

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP proxy URL for downloading embedding models. Fallback if HTTPS_PROXY is not set.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL
envVars.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are rejected regardless (resolution-time check; see the documented DNS TOCTOU limitation in the hosted-deployment runbook).

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER
envVars.description: Escape hatch for MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true WITHOUT inbound-token introspection: set to "true" ONLY when an upstream gateway already verifies Bearer tokens. The server logs a prominent warning and forwards tokens upstream unverified.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.

envVars.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Upstream API root. Required: your user key is exchanged for a session token against this host, and the server will not start without it.

envVars.name: MCP_AUTH_USER_KEY
envVars.description: Long-lived EAD Enterprise Suite user key, exchanged automatically for a short-lived session token. Use it for headless or automated access instead of an account password. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum accepted POST /mcp request-body size in bytes (default 16777216 = 16 MiB — sized so base64 file uploads within the documented tool limits fit). Oversized requests get a 413 JSON-RPC error before/while reading — closes a memory-exhaustion DoS vector in public deployments. Note: base64 file sources are capped by this limit BEFORE MCP_FILE_MAX_BYTES applies.

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC
envVars.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless (1) MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set AND (2) inbound Bearer introspection is configured (MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL + MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID/SECRET) or MCP_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_BEARER=true is set explicitly (fail-closed).

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Client ID this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite.

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Client secret this server presents to the introspection endpoint above (its resource-server credentials). Only needed alongside MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL; it does not authenticate you to EAD Enterprise Suite. (See https://www.eadtrust.eu/soluciones-legaltech/enterprise-suite/ for credential acquisition.)

envVars.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL
envVars.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in, and required when MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC=true. Leave empty for stdio (local) use.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode

envVars.name: EARVELDAJA_DEFAULT_CONNECTION

envVars.name: EARVELDAJA_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Absolute path to a regular file. When set, everything the server writes to stderr is also appended to this file (mode 0o600). Off by default. Cross-platform. Useful when the MCP host swallows stderr. Pipes, devices, sockets, /dev/stdout, and /proc/self/fd/* are refused so the tee cannot corrupt the MCP stdio transport.

name: io.github.IvanBBaev/facebook-mcp
description: Facebook Pages MCP server for the Meta Graph API — publishing, insights, moderation, messaging

envVars.name: FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN
envVars.description: System-user access token (Business Manager). Takes precedence over FB_ACCESS_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_TOKEN when several are set.

envVars.name: FB_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Primary user access token. At least one of FB_SYSTEM_TOKEN, FB_ACCESS_TOKEN or FB_PAGE_TOKEN must be set.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_TOKEN
envVars.description: Long-lived Page access token used as a fallback credential when no user or system-user token is configured.

envVars.name: FB_APP_ID
envVars.description: Meta app ID; combined with FB_APP_SECRET it forms the app access token used to authorize /debug_token inspection.

envVars.name: FB_APP_SECRET
envVars.description: Meta app secret. When set, appsecret_proof is attached to every call so a stolen bare token cannot be used on its own.

envVars.name: FB_PAGE_ID
envVars.description: Default Facebook Page ID, used when a tool call omits an explicit profile argument.

envVars.name: FB_API_VERSION
envVars.description: Graph API version to target. Defaults to the tested pinned version; other values are accepted verbatim as an escape hatch but are not tested.

envVars.name: FB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds; integer in [1, 600000].

envVars.name: FB_HOST_CONCURRENCY
envVars.description: Maximum number of in-flight requests per Graph host; integer in [1, 64].

envVars.name: FB_MAX_RESULT_CHARS
envVars.description: Character budget applied by the result shaper before a tool result is truncated; integer in [500, 10000000].

envVars.name: FB_WRITE_MODE
envVars.description: Write gating mode: plan (validating dry-run preview, the default) or apply. It never covers the irreversible and spend tiers, which always need a per-call apply plus a plan_id.

envVars.name: FB_CONFIRM_TOKEN
envVars.description: Operator confirmation token for out-of-band approval of irreversible or spend actions. The server prompts through MCP elicitation where the client supports it; otherwise the caller passes this value as the confirm_token tool argument.

envVars.name: FB_MEDIA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory permitted for local media uploads. Unset means URL-only uploads and no local file access at all.

envVars.name: FB_JOURNAL_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the append-only write journal. Defaults to the XDG/%APPDATA% state path; the file is created owner-only (0600) and rotates by size.

envVars.name: FB_TOOL_PACKAGES
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool packages or profiles to expose (e.g. core,posts,reader, or the profiles core|all|reader|publisher|moderator|ads). Omit for the default profile, which excludes ads.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages to exclude even when FB_TOOL_PACKAGES enables them. Deny wins over allow.

envVars.name: FB_PACKAGES_READONLY
envVars.description: Comma-separated packages whose write tools are not registered at all; the read tools of those packages stay available.

envVars.name: FB_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Transport protocol: stdio (default) or http. The http transport binds 127.0.0.1 only and fails closed without FB_HTTP_TOKEN.

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token guarding the HTTP transport; required when FB_TRANSPORT=http (the server refuses to start without it).

envVars.name: FB_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port for the HTTP transport (loopback only); used when FB_TRANSPORT=http. Integer in [1, 65535].

envVars.name: FB_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Default ad account ID (act_… or the bare numeric id) for the opt-in ads package.

envVars.name: FB_ADS_BUDGET_CEILING
envVars.description: Hard ceiling for any ads budget write, in minor currency units (e.g. cents). Non-negative integer; a write above it is refused.

envVars.name: FB_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. Logs never go to stdout — that is the stdio protocol channel.

envVars.name: X_MCP_CLIENT_ID

envVars.name: X_MCP_TOKEN_KEYCHAIN

envVars.name: X_MCP_POLICY_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to allow on top of the preset (e.g. read:dm,write:dm).

envVars.name: X_MCP_POLICY_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated op:domain cells to deny; deny beats allow beats preset.

envVars.name: X_MCP_HIDE_DENIED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to drop policy-denied tools from registration entirely instead of registering them annotated as denied.

envVars.name: X_MCP_MEDIA_DIR
envVars.description: Directory uploads must resolve inside. Media upload is disabled unless this is set.

envVars.name: X_MCP_AVAILABILITY
envVars.description: Comma-separated specially-provisioned access classes to declare: pilot, premium-user, enterprise. Unset means the conservative default (app+user, user-only).

envVars.name: X_MCP_PROFILES_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a profiles file holding named configuration blocks.

envVars.name: X_MCP_PROFILE
envVars.description: Name of the profile to select from the profiles file.

envVars.name: X_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-HTTP-request timeout in milliseconds (default 30000).

envVars.name: X_MCP_LOG_LEVEL

envVars.name: X_MCP_CREDIT_BUDGET

For the X-Ray backend this is decorative only (e.g. https://xray.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) - never dereferenced for a live request.

envVars.name: BACKEND_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key or auth token. Required for Traceloop, Datadog, Sentry, New Relic, and Honeycomb; not used by Jaeger, Tempo, or X-Ray. For New Relic this must be a User API key, not an Ingest or License key; for Honeycomb this must be a Configuration Key, not an Ingest or Management key.

envVars.name: BACKEND_AWS_REGION
envVars.description: AWS region, e.g. us-east-1. Required for the X-Ray backend only - X-Ray authenticates via boto3's standard AWS credential chain, not BACKEND_API_KEY.

envVars.name: BACKEND_NEWRELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: New Relic account ID, required for the New Relic backend only - NerdGraph queries are user-scoped, not account-scoped, so this identifies which account's data to read.

envVars.name: BACKEND_HONEYCOMB_DATASET
envVars.description: Honeycomb dataset slug, required for the Honeycomb backend only - the Query Data API is dataset-scoped.

envVars.name: BACKEND_APP_KEY
envVars.description: Datadog Application key, required in addition to BACKEND_API_KEY for the Datadog backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TEMPO_INSTANCE_ID
envVars.description: Grafana Cloud stack/instance ID, used with BACKEND_API_KEY for Basic Auth (Tempo backend only, required for Grafana Cloud-hosted Tempo, not needed for self-hosted Tempo).

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_ORG
envVars.description: Sentry organization slug, required for the Sentry backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_SENTRY_PROJECT
envVars.description: Sentry project slug, optional for the Sentry backend - narrows queries to one project.

envVars.name: BACKEND_ENVIRONMENTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated environments for the Traceloop backend only.

envVars.name: BACKEND_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Request timeout in seconds.

envVars.name: LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Logging level.

envVars.name: MAX_TRACES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: Maximum traces validated per query (1-1000).

envVars.name: SLOW_REQUEST_THRESHOLD_MS
envVars.description: Logs a WARNING for any backend request slower than this, independent of LOG_LEVEL. Unset disables slow-request logging.

envVars.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Enables opt-in OTel self-instrumentation of tool calls when set. Unset means zero overhead - no TracerProvider is configured and no middleware is registered.

envVars.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
envVars.description: Service name reported in self-instrumentation spans, only used when OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is set.

envVars.name: MCP_INCLUDE_ARGS_IN_SPANS
envVars.description: Include tool call arguments/results as OTel span attributes when self-instrumentation is enabled. Off by default since they may contain sensitive data.

description: MongoDB Model Context Protocol Server

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ALLOW_REQUEST_OVERRIDES
envVars.description: When set to true, allows configuration values to be overridden via request headers and query parameters.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Atlas API client ID for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_API_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Atlas API client secret for authentication. Required for running Atlas tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ASSISTANT_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL for the MongoDB Assistant API.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ATLAS_TEMPORARY_DATABASE_USER_LIFETIME_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds that temporary database users created when connecting to MongoDB Atlas clusters will remain active before being automatically deleted.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names that require user confirmation before execution. Requires the client to support elicitation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_SCOPE
envVars.description: Visibility scope for MongoDB connections created at runtime. With 'session' (the default), each MCP session only sees the connections it created (plus the shared 'preconfigured' one) and they are closed when the session ends — recommended when the HTTP transport is exposed to multiple clients without authentication. With 'global', connections are shared across all sessions and survive session rotation.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING
envVars.description: MongoDB connection string for direct database connections. Optional, if not set, you'll need to call the connect tool before interacting with MongoDB data.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLE_SERVER_SIDE_JS
envVars.description: When set to true, disallows the use of server-side JavaScript operators (such as $where, $function, and $accumulator) in query filters and aggregation pipelines.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of tool names, operation types, and/or categories of tools that will be disabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_DRY_RUN
envVars.description: When true, runs the server in dry mode: dumps configuration and enabled tools, then exits without starting the server.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_ELICITATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds the user has to respond to an elicitation request (such as a tool confirmation prompt) before it fails.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds between export cleanup cycles that remove expired export files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time in milliseconds after which an export is considered expired and eligible for cleanup.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXPORTS_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store exported data files.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_EXTERNALLY_MANAGED_SESSIONS
envVars.description: When true, the HTTP transport allows requests with a session ID supplied externally through the 'mcp-session-id' header. When an external ID is supplied, the initialization request is optional.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_HOST
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerHost` instead. Host address to bind the healthCheck HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HEALTH_CHECK_PORT
envVars.description: Deprecated. Use `monitoringServerPort` instead. Port number for the healthCheck HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `healthCheckHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_BODY_LIMIT
envVars.description: Maximum size of the HTTP request body in bytes (only used when transport is 'http'). This value is passed as the optional limit parameter to the Express.js json() middleware.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HEADERS
envVars.description: Header that the HTTP server will validate when making requests (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http').

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). Use 0 for a random port.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_HTTP_RESPONSE_TYPE
envVars.description: The HTTP response type for tool responses: 'sse' for Server-Sent Events, 'json' for standard JSON responses.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Idle timeout for a client to disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_INDEX_CHECK
envVars.description: When set to true, enforces that query operations must use an index, rejecting queries that perform a collection scan.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOG_PATH
envVars.description: Folder to store logs.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_LOGGERS
envVars.description: Comma separated values of logger types.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_ACTIVE_CONNECTIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of MongoDB connections a single scope (an MCP session by default, see connectionScope) can hold open. When exceeded, the scope's least-recently-used connection is closed and its connectionId revoked. The preconfigured connection does not count towards the limit.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_BYTES_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum size in bytes for results from a find or aggregate tool call. This serves as an upper bound for the responseBytesLimit parameter in those tools.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_DOCUMENTS_PER_QUERY
envVars.description: The maximum number of documents that can be returned by a find or aggregate tool call. For the find tool, the effective limit will be the smaller of this value and the tool's limit parameter.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum number of concurrent sessions the HTTP transport will hold in memory (only used when transport is 'http'). Each session holds a full server instance, transport, and timers, so choose a value based on your deployment's available memory; the default is a conservative safety net rather than a recommended production value.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MAX_TIME_M_S
envVars.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that operations are allowed to run on the MongoDB server. When set, this value is passed as the maxTimeMS option to read operations such as find, aggregate, and count.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MCP_CLIENT_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity level for log messages forwarded to the MCP client.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_FEATURES
envVars.description: Features to expose on the monitoring server (only used when transport is 'http' and monitoringServerHost/monitoringServerPort are set).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_HOST
envVars.description: Host address to bind the monitoring HTTP server to (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerPort` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_MONITORING_SERVER_PORT
envVars.description: Port number for the monitoring HTTP server (only used when transport is 'http'). If provided, `monitoringServerHost` must also be set.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_NOTIFICATION_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Notification timeout for a client to be aware of disconnect (only applies to http transport).

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_PREVIEW_FEATURES
envVars.description: Comma separated values of preview features that are enabled.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: When set to true, only allows read, connect, and metadata operation types, disabling create/update/delete operations.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TELEMETRY
envVars.description: When set to disabled, disables telemetry collection.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Either 'stdio' or 'http'.

envVars.name: MDB_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for Voyage AI embeddings service (required for creating Atlas Local deployments with auto-embed vector search capabilities).

name: io.github.MPP32/mpp32-mcp-server
description: Payment layer for AI agents. One MCP, five protocols, thousands of paid APIs your agent can call.

envVars.name: MPP32_AGENT_KEY
envVars.description: Session key from https://mpp32.org/agent-console. Unlocks the full federated catalog and attributes every call to your dashboard. Optional in legacy mode where only native services are reachable.

envVars.name: MPP32_SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Solana private key used to sign x402 USDC payments locally. Only needed when calling paid services that prefer x402. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

envVars.name: MPP32_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Ethereum L2 private key used to sign Tempo pathUSD payments locally. Optional fallback for paid services when x402 is not available. Stays on your machine, never sent to MPP32 servers.

envVars.name: MPP32_API_URL
envVars.description: Override the API base URL for custom deployments. Defaults to https://mpp32.org.

envVars.description: Set to 1 to allow the live (mutating) Jira reconcile mode; otherwise reconcile is dry-run only.

envVars.description: Transport for the MCP server: 'stdio' (default) or 'http' (the optional Streamable-HTTP transport).

envVars.description: Bind host for the Streamable-HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: Bind port for the Streamable-HTTP transport (1-65535; default 8000).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_PATH
envVars.description: URL path the Streamable-HTTP transport serves on (default /mcp).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact host:port values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowlist of exact Origin values accepted by the Streamable-HTTP DNS-rebinding protection; empty defaults to loopback.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_HTTP_TLS_AT_EDGE
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge TLS is terminated at the edge; required to bind the Streamable-HTTP transport to a non-loopback host.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP
envVars.description: Set to 1 to acknowledge running the Streamable-HTTP transport without a token verifier; required to boot the HTTP transport while auth is off.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ENABLED
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable MCP authentication (the composite token verifier + Resource-Server wiring); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STRATEGIES
envVars.description: Comma-separated, ordered list of token-verifier strategies to compose (closed set: static, jwt, introspection, proxy, custom).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL
envVars.description: OAuth authorization-server issuer URL advertised in the Protected-Resource Metadata (RFC 9728) when auth is enabled.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_RESOURCE_SERVER_URL
envVars.description: The single resource identifier (RFC 8707 audience) for this server; the composite verifier re-checks every accepted token against it.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated scopes a caller must hold; the SDK returns 403 insufficient_scope when a principal lacks one.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_STATIC_TOKENS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the JSON secrets file for the static-bearer verifier (stores only SHA-256 digests of the accepted tokens).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_URI
envVars.description: HTTPS JWKS endpoint the `jwt` verifier fetches signing keys from (an OIDC provider's .well-known/jwks.json).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected `iss` claim for the `jwt` verifier; falls back to REBAR_MCP_AUTH_ISSUER_URL when unset.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALGORITHMS
envVars.description: Comma-separated PINNED, asymmetric-only JWS algorithms for the `jwt` verifier (default RS256,ES256); a symmetric algorithm on a JWKS source is refused.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_LEEWAY
envVars.description: Clock-skew leeway in seconds applied to exp/nbf validation by the `jwt` verifier (default 60).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_REFETCH_COOLDOWN
envVars.description: Minimum seconds between JWKS refetches triggered by an unknown key id (the concurrency-safe flood guard; default 30).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_JWKS_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for the `jwt` verifier's JWKS fetch (default 10).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_EXPECTED_TYP
envVars.description: When set, the `jwt` verifier requires the JWT header `typ` to equal this (e.g. at+JWT per RFC 9068); unset skips the check.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_JWT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_JWKS_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback JWKS host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: The `introspection` verifier's RFC 7662 endpoint URL (must be https://); the opaque token is POSTed here on every request (no caching).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: The client id the `introspection` verifier presents to the Authorization Server via HTTP Basic (client_secret_basic).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the introspection client secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the server refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOST
envVars.description: Set to 1 to permit a private/link-local/loopback introspection endpoint host (SSRF guard is on by default); off by default.

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_INTROSPECTION_ALLOW_MISSING_AUD
envVars.description: Set to 1 to accept an active introspection response that OMITS `aud` (many AS do); off by default (fail-closed reject).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_ENV
envVars.description: The NAME of the env var holding the trusted-proxy shared secret (never the secret itself); must be present + non-empty at startup or the `proxy` verifier refuses to start (fail-closed).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SECRET_HEADER
envVars.description: The header the fronting proxy sends its shared secret on; the identity is trusted only when this matches (constant-time; default x-proxy-auth).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_IDENTITY_HEADER
envVars.description: The header carrying the proxy-authenticated principal identity, trusted only when the secret header validates (default x-forwarded-user).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_PROXY_SCOPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated fixed scope set granted to proxy-authenticated principals; empty by default (the principal holds no scopes).

envVars.name: REBAR_MCP_AUTH_CUSTOM_IMPORT
envVars.description: The `custom` strategy's `module:factory` import string, resolving to a factory that returns a TokenVerifier; a TRUSTED operator config value that loads and executes the operator-configured code at startup (fail-closed on any load error).
