envVars.name: UMBRIEL_PROFILE
envVars.description: Capability profile: 'readonly' (inspect/read only), 'safe' (read + input + window — default), or 'full' (also os + fs tools).

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_OS
envVars.description: Set to '1' to allow the 'os' tools (launch_app/run_program/open_path, kill_process, manage_process, control_service, set_env, registry_get/registry_list/registry_set) AND the 'fs' tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) regardless of profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_ALLOW
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to additionally allow on top of the profile.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_DENY
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or categories to deny, overriding the profile and UMBRIEL_ALLOW.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_CURSOR
envVars.description: Set to 'never' to forbid the real-cursor fallback entirely (strictly cursor-free). By default clicks/drags are cursor-free but fall back to the real hardware cursor when no cursor-free path exists.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FS_ROOT
envVars.description: Sandbox root directory that the fs-category file tools (read_file/write_file/list_dir/stat_path/make_dir/copy_file/move_file/delete_file) are confined to when fs tools are enabled; open_path's path argument is honored too.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to journal every mutating tool call as JSON Lines (tool, category, masked args, ok, observation); secret-bearing args and values are redacted. Unset = no trace.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_FFI_TRACE
envVars.description: File path to a flush-before-call diagnostic journal of every COM vcall (slot, this-pointer, arg count). Each line is written and flushed to the OS BEFORE the native call, so after an uncatchable crash the last line names the faulting call. Has per-call overhead; unset = off. For debugging native faults only.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_AUDIT
envVars.description: Controls the default-on stderr audit of mutating tool calls. 'off' is the explicit opt-out (reported at startup); 'verbose' also audits reads.

envVars.name: UMBRIEL_REDACT
envVars.description: Credential masking (default on). 'off' opts out; a regex value overrides the built-in secret shapes masked in clipboard/env/registry reads and the trace journal.

name: io.github.quackai-org/q402-mcp
description: Q402 - gasless payments, yield, escrow, bridge & NAV triggers on 12 EVM chains. Sandbox-default.

envVars.name: Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Free Trial API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/event - BNB Chain (permanent) + Base (permanent) + Mantle limited-time (2026-08-21~08-28 UTC+9), 500 sponsored TXs, gas covered by Q402. Avalanche trial has ended. BNB and Base payments auto-route to this key when set (same rule for q402_pay and q402_batch_pay up to 5 recipients).

envVars.name: Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY
envVars.description: Recommended path: skip this UI and run `q402_doctor` after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads. Fill this field directly ONLY if your MCP client manages secrets for you. Value is a Paid Multichain API key from https://q402.quackai.ai/payment - full 12-chain support with per-chain Gas Tank. Auto-routed for non-BNB payments and whenever keyScope='multichain' is chosen.

envVars.name: Q402_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode A - real EOA signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) of YOUR MetaMask wallet, used to sign payment authorizations LOCALLY on your machine. After your first payment that wallet shows as 'Smart account' in MetaMask (EIP-7702 delegation, reversible via q402_clear_delegation). Use a fresh wallet, not your main one. Skip this and pick Mode B (Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY) or Mode C (server-managed Agent Wallet) if you'd rather keep your MetaMask untouched. Recommended path: run q402_doctor after install - it stores secrets in ~/.q402/mcp.env, which the server auto-loads.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENTIC_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Mode B - local Agent Wallet signing. Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x + 64 hex chars) exported from your Agent Wallet at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard -> Agent tab -> Export. Signs LOCALLY just like Mode A, but the signer is your dedicated Agent Wallet - your MetaMask EOA is never touched. Pick this for AI-agent automation when you want a dedicated purse with per-tx + daily caps you set on the dashboard.

envVars.name: Q402_ENABLE_REAL_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Live-mode switch. 0 = sandbox (test mode, no funds move - every q402_pay returns a fake hash). 1 = real on-chain payments. Default 1 since v0.5.11: safe because mode only flips to live when a live API key (q402_live_*) is set AND one of (a) a valid 32-byte private key for local signing modes, OR (b) walletMode="agentic-server" with Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY for the server-managed Agent Wallet path. Without either combination, the server stays in sandbox regardless of this flag.

envVars.name: Q402_MAX_AMOUNT_PER_CALL
envVars.description: Per-call USD-equivalent cap for USDC/USDT/RLUSD. Any such q402_pay request with amount above this is rejected before signing. Q (QuackAI) is exempt by design (your own token; recipient allowlist + confirmation still apply). Lower this for a tighter agent blast-radius; raise for treasury-grade transfers.

envVars.name: Q402_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Optional comma-separated lowercase EVM addresses. When set, q402_pay rejects any recipient not on this allowlist.

envVars.name: Q402_RELAY_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Override for the Q402 relay endpoint. Defaults to https://q402.quackai.ai/api. Set explicitly when running against a self-hosted Q402 deployment or a non-canonical environment.

envVars.name: Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS
envVars.description: Server-managed Agent Wallet picker (walletMode='agentic-server' only). Lowercased agent wallet address (the hex 0x... shown on the Agent tab of your dashboard) selecting which of your Agent Wallets to spend from when you hold more than one (max 10 per owner). Omit to use the default wallet. Ignored for the local-signing modes that carry their own private key.

envVars.name: Q402_API_KEY
envVars.description: DEPRECATED legacy single-key env from pre-v0.5.0 installs. The server still reads it as a silent fallback so existing setups keep working, but new users should pick a scoped variant instead. Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY (Free Trial, BNB Chain + Base) and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY (full 12-chain surface) are designed to coexist - BNB and Base payments auto-route to the trial key, other chains use multichain. Only set Q402_API_KEY if you are migrating an existing pre-v0.5.0 install; do NOT set it alongside the scoped variants on a fresh install.

envVars.name: Q402_WALLET_ID
envVars.description: DEPRECATED soft-migration alias for Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS (one release of overlap from v0.6.0). The server still accepts it but logs a deprecation notice. New installs should set Q402_AGENT_WALLET_ADDRESS directly.

envVars.name: Q402_BUILDER_CODE
envVars.description: Optional Base Builder Code for onchain attribution (ERC-8021 / Base Builder Codes). When set, every q402_x402_fetch payment includes your code as the client/intermediary in the x402 payment extension so payments are attributed onchain. Format: 1-32 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores. Leave unset to disable attribution.

name: io.github.sfrangulov/minirag-mcp
description: Local-first RAG MCP server: hybrid search over a folder of your own documents

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: One document root; also the security boundary for file access. Defaults to the process working directory. Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of document roots, e.g. ["/docs/a", "/docs/b"]. Takes precedence over BASE_DIR. An invalid value is a hard configuration error.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: LanceDB index directory. Defaults to <first root>/.minirag/lancedb, so each corpus gets its own index.

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Embedding model cache. Defaults to the platform user cache dir, so the ~220 MB model is downloaded once and shared.

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: fastembed model id. Changing it makes existing vectors incompatible with new queries; pair with a new DB_PATH or a full re-ingest.

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Per-file size limit in bytes, enforced before parsing.

envVars.name: CHUNK_TOKEN_BUDGET
envVars.description: Retrieval-unit size in the embedding model's own tokens. Range 16-128; the ceiling is the model's trained sequence length.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword weight in the weighted RRF fusion, range 0.0-1.0. 0 is vector-only; higher values raise the BM25 contribution.

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Result grouping filter. 'similar' keeps only the closest group; 'related' also keeps the next one. Unset means no grouping filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Drop results whose vector distance exceeds this value. Lower is stricter. Unset means no distance filter.

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Keep chunks from at most this many best-scoring files. Unset means no per-file filter.

envVars.name: RAG_INSTRUCTIONS_APPEND

envVars.description: Override for the timestamp/date column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on DQ_SCHEMA preset.

envVars.description: Override for the severity/dimension column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.description: Override for the check_name column on the DQ checks table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' to synthesize check_name from check_type and table_name.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_SCORE_DATE
envVars.description: Override for the date column on the DQ score-daily table. Default depends on preset.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_SCOPE
envVars.description: Override for the scope column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no per-scope rollup.

envVars.name: DQ_COL_TIER
envVars.description: Override for the tier column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no tier dimension.

envVars.description: When no tier column is configured (us-all preset or DQ_COL_TIER=none), the overall_score threshold dq-tier-status compares against (default 99.5). Superseded by DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH tier_sla.1 if both are set.

envVars.name: DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH
envVars.description: Optional path to a YAML file that defines tier_sla (per-tier overall_score targets) and dbt_sla (test/freshness pass rates). When set, dq-tier-status and dq-tier-by-source read tier targets from this file, and dbt-sla-status compares run_results / sources pass rates against dbt_sla.test_pass_pct / freshness_pass_pct. Mtime cached.

name: io.github.williansaez/abap-adt-mcp
description: ABAP development from Claude and other MCP hosts: source, transports, tests, ATC, debugger

envVars.name: SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a JSON file mapping destination names to system configs (url, client, authType basic/sso/sso2/oauth, credentials). Recommended; keep the file mode 0600. See systems.example.json

envVars.name: SAP_SYSTEMS
envVars.description: Inline JSON map of destinations (same shape as SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE). Contains credentials — prefer SAP_SYSTEMS_FILE

envVars.name: SAP_DEFAULT_DESTINATION
envVars.description: Destination name used when a tool call omits `destination` (alternatively mark an entry with "default": true)

envVars.name: SAP_AUTH_TYPE
envVars.description: Default auth type for entries that don't specify one: sso (default), sso2, basic, or oauth

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
envVars.description: When set (1024-65535), serve Streamable HTTP on http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with bearer-token auth instead of stdio

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
envVars.description: Bind address for the HTTP transport (default 127.0.0.1). Set 0.0.0.0 only inside containers that publish the port

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Bearer token for the HTTP transport; auto-generated and written to ~/.abap-adt-mcp/http-token when unset

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_SESSIONS
envVars.description: Maximum concurrent MCP sessions on the HTTP transport (default 16); further initialize requests get 503

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES
envVars.description: Largest request body the HTTP transport accepts, in bytes (default 4194304); larger bodies are refused with HTTP 413

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES
envVars.description: Idle minutes after which an HTTP session (and its SAP sessions/locks) is closed (default 30)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Origin values allowed on the HTTP transport (loopback origins always allowed when bound to loopback; * allows any)

envVars.name: MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated Host header values allowed (DNS-rebinding protection; loopback hosts always allowed when bound to loopback)

envVars.name: MCP_EXPORT_ROOT
envVars.description: When set, exportPackageSources may only write inside this directory

envVars.name: MCP_AUDIT_FILE
envVars.description: Path of a JSONL audit trail: one record per tool call (tool, destination, duration, outcome ok/error/denied/unavailable, policy gate, redacted argument summary)

envVars.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to 1 to make every destination read-only (server-side; only read-only annotated tools plus login/logout run). Per-destination policies live in systems.json

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW
envVars.description: Set to 1 to let tableContents read table and CDS rows on every destination that does not state policy.allowDataPreview itself (reading table data is off by default)

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_FREE_SQL
envVars.description: Set to 1 to allow runQuery and tableContents with sqlQuery on every destination that does not state policy.allowFreeSql itself (free SQL is off by default; implies table data)

envVars.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Toolsets to publish: comma list (core,source,objects,transports,analysis,tests,atc,data,discovery,runtime,refactoring,rap,services,git,debugger,traces) or a preset: all (default) or focused

envVars.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLSETS
envVars.description: Toolsets to hide, comma list (core cannot be disabled)

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
envVars.description: Character budget for a single tool response before results are paged/truncated (default 40000, minimum 5000). Raise it if your MCP host accepts larger tool outputs

envVars.name: SAP_ALLOW_REENTRANCE_TICKET
envVars.description: Set to 1 to enable the reentranceTicket tool (disabled by default: it returns a live SAP logon credential into the conversation)

envVars.name: SAP_URL
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: base URL of the SAP system, e.g. https://host:44300

envVars.name: SAP_USER
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP username

envVars.name: SAP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP password

envVars.name: SAP_CLIENT
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: SAP client number, e.g. 100

envVars.name: SAP_LANGUAGE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: logon language, e.g. EN

envVars.name: SAP_BROWSER_PATH
envVars.description: SSO destinations: path to a Chromium/Chrome/Edge binary for the browser login (auto-detected when unset)

envVars.name: SAP_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR
envVars.description: SSO destinations: directory of the persistent browser profile that keeps the identity-provider session (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/sso/<host>)

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_COMMAND
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: absolute path to the trusted local ticket provider

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_ARGS
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: JSON array of provider arguments (never put a ticket here)

envVars.name: SAP_SSO2_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Legacy single-system sso2 mode: provider timeout in milliseconds (default 30000; range 1000-300000)

envVars.name: SAP_TLS_INSECURE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode: set to 1 to skip TLS certificate verification for that system only (sandboxes with self-signed certificates)

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_TOKEN_URL
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 token endpoint (client_credentials)

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client id

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: OAuth2 client secret

envVars.name: SAP_OAUTH_SCOPE
envVars.description: Legacy single-system mode with SAP_AUTH_TYPE=oauth: optional OAuth2 scope

envVars.name: MCP_PROFILE_GATE
envVars.description: Platform gate for toolsets the destination does not expose (debugger, traces, abapGit, ...): enforce (default, refuse before calling SAP), warn (log only) or off

envVars.name: MCP_SOURCE_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
envVars.description: Lifetime of the per-session source cache used by grepPackage, cdsViewInfo and syntaxCheckCode (default 300; 0 keeps entries until logout)

envVars.name: MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory for the cached SAP cloudification repository used by apiReleaseState (default ~/.abap-adt-mcp/cache)

envVars.name: MCP_API_CLASSIFICATION_FILES
envVars.description: Extra classification files for apiReleaseState, comma list: a path inside SAP's cloudification repository (partner/objectClassifications_ACME.json) or an https URL

envVars.name: IONOS_TOKEN
envVars.description: IONOS CLOUD API token (required for all products except Object Storage)

envVars.name: IONOS_S3_ACCESS_KEY
envVars.description: S3 access key for IONOS Object Storage

envVars.name: IONOS_S3_SECRET_KEY
envVars.description: S3 secret key for IONOS Object Storage

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_LOAD_MODE
envVars.description: Tool registration strategy (the --load-mode flag overrides this). 'eager' (default): register all tools at startup. 'lazy': defer Compute and Object Storage behind 'ionos_load_compute_tools' / 'ionos_load_objectstorage_tools' sentinel tools (requires MCP client support for notifications/tools/list_changed). 'dynamic' (alias 'search'): expose only the ionos_search_tools / ionos_describe_tools / ionos_call_tool meta-tools and browse the full catalog through them — for clients with hard tool caps and no tool search of their own (Cursor, Windsurf).

envVars.name: IONOS_MCP_TOOL_SCOPE
envVars.description: Opt in to write operations. Unset (default) leaves the server read-only: only list_/get_/head_ tools are registered. 'write' additionally registers create_/update_ tools and the non-disruptive actions (start_, resume_, attach_, assign_); 'destructive' also registers delete_ and the disruptive actions (stop_, reboot_, suspend_, upgrade_, restore_, detach_, recreate_, import_) and implies 'write'. Comma-separated, case-insensitive, hierarchical; unrecognised values stay read-only. WARNING: enabling this lets an AI model provision, modify and delete billable resources in a live IONOS CLOUD account. Every create and delete requires a two-phase confirmation, but that cannot stop a client configured to approve tool calls automatically. Leave unset unless writes are needed.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LOG_FORMAT

envVars.name: OLLAMA_HOST

envVars.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: OpenAI API key for the openai embedding provider, and the fallback key for the summarize tool when MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY is unset. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OpenAI ecosystem convention.

envVars.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Voyage AI API key for the voyage embedding provider. Bare (not MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_-prefixed), matching the OPENAI_API_KEY / OLLAMA_HOST convention. Setting it never auto-selects the provider; choose it explicitly with MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=voyage.

envVars.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL (embeddings). For the summarize tool it only routes traffic when an API key already enables the feature; it never enables summarize by itself.

envVars.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Bare fallback for MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-backed tool or resource waits for the FTS index to become queryable during a cold-start background build before raising IndexUnavailableError(reason="timeout"). Increase for large vaults.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Maximum seconds an index-querying read tool waits for the IndexWriter to drain when called with wait_for_pending_writes=true. On timeout the tool answers from the current index and reports index_stale=true in the response _meta.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SOURCE_DIR
envVars.description: Path to the markdown vault directory. When it does not exist, or the server cannot access it, the server starts but every tool fails with a message saying which until it is fixed (managed git mode clones into it). Symbolic links inside the vault are followed on Python 3.13+.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_READ_ONLY
envVars.description: Set to true to hide the write tools (write, edit, append, delete, rename, move_folder, fetch, git_sync, the okf_* tools, create_upload_link) and serve a search-only vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_WRITE_PROTECT_EXISTING
envVars.description: Refuse a write that would overwrite an existing file when no if_match etag is supplied. Deliberate replacement still works: read the file first, then pass if_match. Unaffected: edit, append, delete, rename. Set to false to allow blind overwrites.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DISABLE_APPS_UI
envVars.description: Hide the MCP Apps UI tools (browse_vault, show_context) from the tool listing for clients that do not render MCP Apps panels.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEX_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the SQLite FTS5 index file; unset keeps the index in memory. Set it for persistence across restarts.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the change-tracking state file. Defaults to {SOURCE_DIR}/.markdown_vault_mcp/state.json.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDINGS_PATH
envVars.description: Path to the numpy embeddings file; required to enable semantic search.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_INDEXED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields promoted to the tag index for structured filtering. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup; SEARCHABLE_FIELDS inherits this value when unset.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_REQUIRED_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields required on every document; documents missing any are excluded from the index.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EXCLUDE
envVars.description: Comma-separated glob patterns excluded from scanning, e.g. .obsidian/**,.trash/**.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TITLE_FIELD
envVars.description: Frontmatter field used as the document title (falls back to title, the first H1, then the filename). Changing it cold-rebuilds the index once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SEARCHABLE_FIELDS
envVars.description: Comma-separated frontmatter fields whose text values become keyword-searchable and enrich first-chunk embeddings. Inherits INDEXED_FIELDS when unset; the sentinel none means filterable but not searchable. Changing it cold-rebuilds the index and re-embeds once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TEMPLATES_FOLDER
envVars.description: Relative folder where note templates live (used by the create_from_template prompt).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_PROMPTS_FOLDER
envVars.description: Directory of .md prompt files that extend or override built-in prompts; a relative path is resolved against SOURCE_DIR.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CONVENTIONS_FILE
envVars.description: Filename of the per-folder conventions files surfaced to clients at write time (bare .md filename without glob characters). Set to none to disable folder conventions.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_MODE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) read semantics. With auto (the default), read annotations switch on when the vault declares an OKF version in its root index.md. Use off to disable OKF semantics entirely, or on to force them for an undeclared vault. Annotations are read-only; write behavior is never affected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_WRITE
envVars.description: OKF (Open Knowledge Format) enforced write layer. When true on an OKF-active vault, the server stamps generated provenance on each write and clears any verified attestation when a note's content changes. It also keeps each written folder's log.md and index.md current, and exposes the okf_verify tool. Requires OKF_MODE to be auto or on (a true value with OKF_MODE=off is a config error). Off by default.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OKF_VERIFY
envVars.description: How the okf_verify tool attributes a human review. This applies only when OKF_WRITE is on, which gates the tool. With elicit (the default), okf_verify asks the human to confirm the review through an MCP elicitation, then records the attestation only on an affirmative reply. It fails closed when the client cannot elicit or the human declines, so a model holding the human's token cannot self-attest. Set trust-auth instead to attribute to a token's sub claim with no confirmation; it rejects static bearer credentials and other client-ID-only identities. This is safe only when the sole caller is a human-driven UI. Set off to hide the tool, leaving attestation to external tooling. A non-default value with OKF_WRITE off is a config error.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_ATTACHMENT_EXTENSIONS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed attachment extensions (e.g. pdf,png,jpg); case and a leading dot are ignored, so PDF and .pdf name the same type. Use * to allow every non-markdown file. Unset selects the built-in allowlist. A link whose target has a listed extension is not part of the link graph; changing the list rebuilds the index once.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE_MB
envVars.description: Maximum attachment size in MB returned by read / accepted by write; 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_NOTE_READ_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum bytes returned by a full-document read of a note; use `read(path, section=…)` for partial reads. 0 disables the limit.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_DEFAULT_SEARCH_MODE
envVars.description: Mode used when a search call omits 'mode': auto, keyword, semantic, or hybrid. The default 'auto' picks hybrid when embeddings are configured and keyword when they are not. Pin 'keyword' to keep unqualified searches off the embedding provider (each hybrid or semantic search embeds the query, which costs an API call on a metered provider). A configured semantic/hybrid default also degrades to keyword without embeddings, so no setting can make a vault unsearchable; an explicit mode= argument is never downgraded.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNKS_PER_FILE
envVars.description: Maximum chunks returned per document in search results.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SNIPPET_WORDS
envVars.description: Width of the snippet window (words) in search results; 0 returns full chunk content.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_LENGTH_DOWNWEIGHT_ALPHA
envVars.description: Down-weights longer chunks in ranking: score / (1 + alpha * log(chunk_count)).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_WORDS
envVars.description: Word cap per chunk; the adaptive chunker splits at deeper heading levels, then paragraph/word boundaries, to respect it. Match it to the embedding model's context. A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_MAX_CHUNK_CHARS
envVars.description: Character cap enforced alongside MAX_CHUNK_WORDS to bound token-dense chunks. Unset derives min(1500, model context * 2.8). Set a positive value for an exact cap, or -1 to scale with the model's full context (can exhaust memory on long-context models). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_CHUNK_OVERLAP_WORDS
envVars.description: Words of overlap between adjacent budget-split fragments of the same heading section (0 disables). A reindex applies a new value.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FOLDER_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Folder-prefix score multipliers (`prefix:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights > 0) applied to all search modes; the deepest matching prefix wins (sessions:0.5 demotes sessions/**).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FTS_WEIGHTS
envVars.description: Per-column BM25 weights (`column:weight` pairs, comma-separated, weights >= 0) for keyword ranking. Columns: path, title, folder, heading, content, summary.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding provider: openai, voyage, ollama, or fastembed. Unset auto-detects from the environment (never voyage). Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with openai plus OPENAI_BASE_URL; see the embeddings guide.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_MODEL
envVars.description: Ollama embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OLLAMA_CPU_ONLY
envVars.description: Force Ollama to embed on CPU only.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_VOYAGE_MODEL
envVars.description: Voyage AI embedding model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings; the bare OPENAI_BASE_URL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible embedding model name; the bare OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL is honoured as a fallback.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_MODEL
envVars.description: FastEmbed model name.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: FastEmbed model cache directory (in Docker, stored under /data/state/fastembed).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_CONTEXT
envVars.description: Enrich embedding input with the note title, chunk heading, and (first chunk) searchable-field values. Flipping it re-embeds the whole vault once on next startup.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBED_TIMEOUT_S
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single embedding HTTP call (OpenAI/Ollama). The local FastEmbed backend runs in-process with no network call and ignores this. CPU-only or large-model workloads may need 60-120 s; raise this if batches time out.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE
envVars.description: Number of chunks sent per embedding request. Smaller batches shorten each request (useful under a tight timeout on slow models) at the cost of more round-trips.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_TOKEN
envVars.description: Token/password for HTTPS git auth; remotes must be HTTPS when set.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_REPO_URL
envVars.description: HTTPS remote URL for managed git mode: the server clones into an empty SOURCE_DIR on startup (or validates an existing origin) and enables the pull loop, auto-commit, and deferred push.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_USERNAME
envVars.description: Username for HTTPS git auth prompts (x-access-token for GitHub, oauth2 for GitLab, the account name for Bitbucket).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PULL_INTERVAL_S
envVars.description: Seconds between git fetch + fast-forward update attempts; 0 disables periodic pull.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_PUSH_DELAY_S
envVars.description: Seconds of write-idle time before pushing; 0 pushes only on shutdown.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME
envVars.description: Git committer name for auto-commits; set this in Docker where git config user.name is empty.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL
envVars.description: Git committer email for auto-commits.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_NAME_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author name (e.g. name); overrides GIT_COMMIT_NAME per request when an OIDC token is present. The claim is resolved when the tool call arrives and carried to the background commit, so it applies on every write. A configured claim the token does not carry is reported once at WARNING and the static identity is used.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL_CLAIM
envVars.description: OIDC claim key used as the commit author email (e.g. email); overrides GIT_COMMIT_EMAIL per request when an OIDC token is present. Resolved and carried the same way as the name claim.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GIT_LFS
envVars.description: Run git lfs pull on startup to fetch LFS-tracked attachments; set to false for repos without LFS.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER
envVars.description: Watch the vault for external filesystem changes; auto-disabled when git pull is active or a webhook can deliver (HTTP/SSE transports only). Requires the file-watcher extra.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_DEBOUNCE_S
envVars.description: Seconds of quiet after the last filesystem event before reindexing.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_FILE_WATCHER_ROOT_FLOOR
envVars.description: Keep the non-recursive watch on the vault root; set false to register zero source-dir-rooted FSEvents streams (avoids repeated macOS access prompts on a home-rooted vault) at the cost of root-level files relying on scans.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_BOOT_REINDEX
envVars.description: Reconcile offline changes at startup by reindexing once the initial build completes. Set false on a large vault to start without paying a full filesystem scan per server start; changes made while no server was running are then invisible until a reindex runs (the reindex tool, or 'markdown-vault-mcp reindex'). Note that `index_stale` reports writer idleness, not agreement with disk, so it reads false while the index may still differ from the vault.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
envVars.description: Shared secret for the GitHub push-event webhook; when set, mounts POST /github-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_TOKEN
envVars.description: Signing token for the GitLab push-event webhook (GitLab 19.0+); when set, mounts POST /gitlab-webhook on HTTP/SSE transports to trigger an immediate pull + reindex on push events. GitLab generates this value; copy the `whsec_` token it shows under Generate signing token rather than inventing one. Deliveries are authenticated by HMAC-SHA256 over the webhook id, timestamp and body, and a delivery older than 5 minutes is rejected.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET_TOKEN
envVars.description: Secret token for the GitLab push-event webhook, GitLab's plain-text form and the only one below 19.0; also mounts POST /gitlab-webhook. It proves nothing about the body and cannot expire, so prefer the signing token where the GitLab version offers it. Setting both accepts either, which is how an existing webhook migrates.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Summarization backend (only openai is recognised). Unset auto-detects: the backend activates when credentials or an explicit endpoint are present.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_API_KEY
envVars.description: API key for the OpenAI-compatible summarize endpoint; the bare OPENAI_API_KEY is honoured as a fallback. Unset works for keyless local endpoints (Ollama).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint base URL for the summarize tool; setting it enables the tool even without an API key. The bare OPENAI_BASE_URL routes traffic only when a key already enables the feature.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_OPENAI_MODEL
envVars.description: Chat model id used for summaries.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Upper bound on generated tokens per summarize call; on reasoning models this budget also covers internal reasoning tokens.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_NOTES
envVars.description: Cap on the number of notes summarised in one call (subtree expansion truncates to this many).

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_MAX_INPUT_CHARS
envVars.description: Aggregate cap on note characters sent to the model in one call; excess is truncated with a flag on the result.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_SUMMARIZE_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: Per-request wall-clock budget in seconds for a single summarize backend call; keep it below the MCP client's request timeout so the server-side error wins the race.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_DEFAULT_S
envVars.description: Link lifetime in seconds when the caller requests no explicit TTL.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_TTL_MAX_S
envVars.description: Ceiling in seconds a caller-requested link TTL is clamped to.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_GRACE_TTL_S
envVars.description: Post-success grace window in seconds: a served token's TTL shrinks to this so a stalled transfer can retry within it.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_LEASE_S
envVars.description: Crashed-handler reclaim window in seconds for an in-flight reservation.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_TRANSFER_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single upload.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_SOFT_DEADLINE_S
envVars.description: Seconds a long-running tool call may run in the foreground before it is promoted to a background job and a job handle is returned instead.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_RESULT_TTL_S
envVars.description: Seconds a background-job record (working or finished) is retained for polling before it expires from the store.

envVars.name: MARKDOWN_VAULT_MCP_JOBS_MAX_PER_SUBJECT
envVars.description: Maximum live background jobs per calling subject; further promotions are rejected until older records expire.

envVars.description: Set to true to accept a self-signed certificate on the configured host only (default: false)

envVars.name: CALDAV_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT
envVars.description: Set to true to allow a plain http:// URL to a host that is not loopback, which sends the credentials unencrypted (default: false)

name: ni-c/smtp-mcp
description: Send, reply to and forward mail over SMTP, restricted to a recipient allowlist, with each message approved by a person before sending.

envVars.name: SMTP_HOST
envVars.description: Hostname of the SMTP server, e.g. smtp.example.net.

envVars.name: SMTP_PORT
envVars.description: Port. Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for implicit, 25 for none.

envVars.name: SMTP_TLS
envVars.description: starttls (default), implicit or none. STARTTLS is required, never opportunistic.

envVars.name: SMTP_USER
envVars.description: Username for SMTP authentication.

envVars.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
envVars.description: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication.

envVars.name: SMTP_FROM
envVars.description: The only sender this server will use, e.g. "Name <person@example.net>". There is no from parameter.

envVars.name: SMTP_REPLY_TO
envVars.description: Reply-To header on every message, e.g. "Team <team@example.net>". Unset means no Reply-To header and replies go to SMTP_FROM. There is no reply_to parameter.

envVars.name: SMTP_ALLOW_SEND
envVars.description: Set to "true" to register the sending tools. Defaults to false: the server cannot send until it is set.

envVars.name: SMTP_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to. Required with SMTP_ALLOW_SEND=true; "*" allows any.

envVars.name: SMTP_MAX_RECIPIENTS
envVars.description: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message. Default 10.

envVars.name: SMTP_MAX_SENDS_PER_HOUR
envVars.description: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent. Default 20.

envVars.name: SMTP_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size of the composed message. Default 10485760.

envVars.name: SMTP_MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES
envVars.description: Maximum size of a single attachment. Default 5242880.

envVars.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_DIR
envVars.description: Directory attachments are read from. Unset means attachments are unavailable.

envVars.name: SMTP_ATTACHMENT_TYPES
envVars.description: Comma-separated content types that may be attached. Defaults to a document and image allowlist.

envVars.name: SMTP_SIGNATURE
envVars.description: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message.

envVars.name: SMTP_AUDIT_LOG
envVars.description: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr.

envVars.name: SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset.

envVars.name: SMTP_DENY_TOOLS
envVars.description: Comma-separated tool names or prefixes to remove, applied after SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS.

envVars.name: SMTP_INSECURE_TLS
envVars.description: Set to "true" to accept self-signed certificates. Prefer a proper internal CA.

envVars.description: Namespace used when a tool call does not name one. There is no default; without this, every call must name a namespace.

envVars.description: Embedding model used when a tool call does not name one, for example Qwen3-Embedding-4B.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS
envVars.description: Embedding dimensionality used when a tool call does not name one, for example 1024. Must match the model.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_DISABLE_GLOBAL_NS
envVars.description: Set to 1 to close the shared "global" namespace on this server. Every call that routes there is refused before the request is sent, and the tools stop offering it as an example. Unset leaves it available. A value that is neither a yes nor a no stops the server rather than being read as no.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_URL
envVars.description: An OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings endpoint you run. Set it and embeddings are computed on this machine rather than by Noetive: a publish carries the vector alongside its text, and a query's anchor phrases are replaced by vectors so they are never sent. This is not confidential publishing: message text still travels, because that is what a search returns. The endpoint must answer to the same model name as NOETIVE_MODEL and return NOETIVE_DIMENSIONS values. Plain http is accepted only for a loopback address. Inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself; use host.docker.internal.

envVars.name: NOETIVE_EMBEDDINGS_KEY_SECRET
envVars.description: Bearer token for that endpoint, when it needs one. Endpoints running on your own machine usually do not.

envVars.description: Where to store the SQLite index + embedding cache. Defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/obsidian-brain or ~/.local/share/obsidian-brain.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PRESET
envVars.description: Preset name: english (default, bge-small-en-v1.5), english-fast, english-quality, multilingual, multilingual-quality, multilingual-ollama. Ignored when EMBEDDING_MODEL is set.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
envVars.description: Power-user override: any transformers.js checkpoint or Ollama model id. Takes precedence over EMBEDDING_PRESET. Switching auto-reindexes.

envVars.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
envVars.description: Embedding backend. 'transformers' (local, default) or 'ollama' (requires a running Ollama server).

envVars.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of a local Ollama server. Only used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIM
envVars.description: Override the embedding dimensionality when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama. If unset, the server probes the model on startup.

envVars.name: OLLAMA_NUM_CTX
envVars.description: Override Ollama's num_ctx for embed requests. Leave UNSET to let obsidian-brain auto-detect via `/api/show`'s `context_length` (e.g. nomic-embed-text=2048, bge-m3=8192, qwen3-embedding:0.6b=32 768). Setting this manually imposes a hard cap and may silently truncate longer inputs — see https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/14259. Ollama's own default is 2048 which truncates for any model trained on a larger context. See also https://github.com/ollama/ollama/issues/7008. Fallback when both env is unset AND /api/show is unreachable: 8192.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Auto-pull the configured Ollama model when /api/show returns 404 (model not present). Default ON — choosing an Ollama-backed preset is implicit consent to download its model. Streams /api/pull progress to stderr. Set to '0' to disable auto-pull entirely (master kill-switch) and fall back to the actionable error path (`HTTP 404 — try: ollama pull <model>`).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_BYOM_AUTO_PULL
envVars.description: Opt-in to auto-pull for BYOM (custom EMBEDDING_MODEL) Ollama models OUTSIDE Ollama's official `library/` namespace. Default OFF — third-party models (e.g. `user/custom-fork`, `myregistry.com/team/model`) require this env var to be set to `1` before they will auto-pull, to prevent silent downloads of arbitrary user-named artifacts. Preset-known models (via EMBEDDING_PRESET) and bare model ids in the official library (e.g. `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`, `library/llama3:8b`) continue to auto-pull by default per the existing OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_OLLAMA_AUTO_PULL behavior.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH
envVars.description: Set to '1' to disable the live chokidar file watcher. Useful on SMB/NFS vaults where FSEvents/inotify don't fire reliably — fall back to running `obsidian-brain index` on a schedule (launchd/systemd).

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_CATCHUP
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip the startup catchup reindex pass that picks up edits made while the server was down. The live file watcher still starts (via OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_NO_WATCH=1 to disable that separately), and first-time indexing on an empty DB is unaffected — this knob only governs the post-restart `enqueueBackgroundReindex` walk.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Per-file reindex debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_COMMUNITY_DEBOUNCE_MS
envVars.description: Graph-wide community-detection (Louvain) debounce for the live watcher, in milliseconds. Louvain is the only expensive op — batching it prevents per-edit CPU spikes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Tools exceeding this return an MCP error instead of hanging.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_MAX_CHUNK_TOKENS
envVars.description: Override the adaptive chunk-size budget (in tokens). When set, this beats the capacity probed from the model's tokenizer or Ollama /api/show. Use for debugging or for models with stale tokenizer configs.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_CONFIG_DIR
envVars.description: Override the per-user config directory where obsidian-brain stores model overrides (`model-overrides.json`) and the user-fetched seed (`seed-models.json`). Default is `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/obsidian-brain` on macOS/Linux (or `~/.config/obsidian-brain`) and `%APPDATA%/obsidian-brain` on Windows. Both files survive `npm update obsidian-brain` because they live outside the package.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_DEBUG
envVars.description: Set to "1" to print a verbose synchronous startup trace to stderr — every preflight, createContext, server.connect, and shutdown step is logged with a monotonic timestamp. The LAST line before any silent failure tells you exactly which step the server reached. No-op when unset (no overhead). Use to diagnose silent-crash failure modes.

envVars.name: OBSIDIAN_BRAIN_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Set to 'ndjson' for one-JSON-object-per-line stderr output (timestamp + level + message + structured fields). Default is human-readable plain text (`obsidian-brain: <message>`). Useful for piping logs into aggregators (Datadog, Loki, Vector, journald) that index structured fields.

name: OpenGrok MCP Server
description: MCP server bridging OpenGrok search engine with AI for instant context across massive codebases.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_BASE_URL
envVars.description: OpenGrok server base URL (e.g. https://opengrok.example.com/source/)

envVars.name: OPENGROK_USERNAME
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication username. Leave unset for anonymous access.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
envVars.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
envVars.description: Enable Code Mode: 2-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Reduces AI token usage by ~90%.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_MEMORY_TOOLS
envVars.description: Register the 3 memory tools in Code Mode (memory status, read, update). Off = api + execute only.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
envVars.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
envVars.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION
envVars.description: OpenGrok REST API version. Use v2 for call graph features (requires OpenGrok 1.12+).

envVars.name: HTTP_PROXY
envVars.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE
envVars.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS
envVars.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
envVars.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING
envVars.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
envVars.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API
envVars.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER
envVars.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS
envVars.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS
envVars.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE
envVars.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM
envVars.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT
envVars.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT
envVars.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS
envVars.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP
envVars.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF
envVars.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).

envVars.name: OPENGROK_JWT_ISSUER
envVars.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

envVars.name: OPENGROK_GRAMMAR_DIR
envVars.description: Directory containing tree-sitter WASM grammars. Overrides the bundled grammar lookup.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_KV_STORE_URL

When unset, defaults to `file:///data/state` (the volume family Docker images mount), or to `memory://` (with a warning) on a host where that directory is not usable.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA
envVars.description: Deployment-specific behavioral policy added to the generated MCP instructions.

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_INSTRUCTIONS
envVars.description: Legacy: replaces all generated MCP instructions (deprecated; use _INSTANCE_DESCRIPTION for routing and _INSTRUCTIONS_EXTRA for policy).

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_LEVEL

envVars.name: PAPERLESS_MCP_LOG_FORMAT
envVars.description: Log rendering. rich is one colour event key=value line per record, for a terminal; json is one JSON object per record, for a collector. Unset picks rich when stderr is a terminal and json everywhere else, so a container or journald gets JSON with no configuration.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
envVars.description: Absolute path of a sandboxed directory where outputMode='file' may write PDFs. Unset: every tool returns base64 only (file output disabled).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches encrypt/decrypt, sign, timestamp, add_ltv, update_metadata, encrypted builds or file output.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless). Unauthenticated unless PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Never logged.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_MAX_INFLATE_BYTES
envVars.description: Per-stream FlateDecode decompression cap in bytes (zip-bomb mitigation; default 104857600 = 100 MiB). Integer >= 1024; an invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE
envVars.description: ISO 8601 instant with a time zone (e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) pinned as the creation date of every generated document: reproducible bytes on any host. A call's own creationDate still wins. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
envVars.description: reproducible-builds.org convention: integer seconds since the Unix epoch, used as the pinned creation date when PDFNATIVE_MCP_CREATION_DATE is unset. An invalid value refuses to start the server.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_URL
envVars.description: http(s) URL of the RFC 3161 timestamp authority used by sign_pdf timestamp=true and timestamp_pdf (PAdES B-T / B-LTA). Unset: those calls fail with TSA_NOT_CONFIGURED and no network request is made. Tool arguments can never supply a URL.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_TSA_AUTH
envVars.description: Optional Authorization header value sent to the TSA (e.g. 'Basic ...' or 'Bearer ...'). Never logged or echoed.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION
envVars.description: 'ocsp', 'crl' or 'ocsp,crl': enables online revocation collection for add_ltv mode='online' (PAdES B-LT). Unset: that mode fails with REVOCATION_NOT_CONFIGURED; mode='offline' stays fully offline. Requires PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allow-list of OCSP / CRL responder hosts ('host', 'host:port' or '*.suffix'). Mandatory when PDFNATIVE_MCP_REVOCATION is set: responder URLs found in certificates are fetched only if the host matches (http(s) only, no credentials, no redirects, internal addresses rejected unless listed verbatim).

envVars.name: PDFNATIVE_MCP_NETWORK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-request timeout for TSA / OCSP / CRL calls in milliseconds, 1000-120000 (default 10000).

envVars.description: Pay across several chains (instead of PIPRAIL_CHAIN): a comma-separated list, e.g. base,polygon,solana. envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_AMOUNT

envVars.description: Lifetime spend cap per token, in token units (default: 10.00).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_TOTAL_DENOM
envVars.description: Cross-token GRAND TOTAL: one spend cap per denomination across every stablecoin and chain, e.g. USD:20.00,EUR:5.00. Not a price oracle — sums tokens of the same unit, each counted 1:1. Native coins are excluded.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS
envVars.description: Lifetime cap on the NUMBER of payments, across every chain + token (e.g. 100).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_MAX_PAYMENTS_PER_WINDOW
envVars.description: Cap on the number of payments within PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS (a rolling rate limit; set PIPRAIL_WINDOW_SECONDS too).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_WARN_AT_FRACTION
envVars.description: Emit an early-warning event when spend crosses this fraction of any cap, e.g. 0.8 (80%). Needs PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG to be visible.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SPEND_LOG
envVars.description: Path to a local append-only spend log. When set, the budget (lifetime, grand total, counts) SURVIVES a restart — hydrated from this file. No backend; you own the file.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_EVENT_LOG
envVars.description: Mirror payment events (settled / declined / budget-threshold) as one-line JSON to 'stderr' or a file path — the operator's notification stream. Default: off.

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_TOKENS
envVars.description: Comma-separated allowed token symbols, plus the alias 'native' for the chain's coin (default: USDC).

envVars.name: PIPRAIL_SCHEMES
envVars.description: Comma-separated payment schemes to settle (default: onchain-proof). Add 'exact' (onchain-proof,exact) to also pay standard x402 servers GASLESS on EVM + Solana (method auto-selected). Add 'upto' to also pay metered x402 servers on EVM (Permit2): sign a MAX, the server settles the actual <= max.

envVars.name: CONFIG
envVars.description: Path to your configuration file

envVars.name: MCP_ALLOW_STATIC_FALLBACK
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to allow HTTP startup when config.json has static credentials. Otherwise the server refuses to start, preventing silent shared-identity fallback for unauthenticated requests.

envVars.name: MCP_CONTENT_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Byte cap for the content bodies and result blocks tools return (wikitext, rendered HTML, diffs, statement and row listings). An oversized response is truncated with a trailing marker describing what was left out.

envVars.name: MCP_FILE_DATA_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Hard cap on the base64-encoded size of a get-file-data response. A transport/safety backstop; callers tune actual size with the tool's width parameter. Over-cap responses error rather than truncate.

envVars.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
envVars.description: Minimum severity for logger output (stderr telemetry and sendLoggingMessage broadcast). Invalid values fail loudly on first log call.

envVars.name: MCP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY
envVars.description: Maximum HTTP request body size on the StreamableHTTP transport. Accepts size strings like 1mb or 512kb.

envVars.name: MCP_METRICS
envVars.description: Set to 'true' to expose Prometheus metrics at GET /metrics on the HTTP transport. Has no effect on the stdio transport.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_ALLOWED_REDIRECTS
envVars.description: Additional allowed redirect URIs for hosted-proxy client registration: comma-separated exact URIs (which must include a host) and https prefix patterns ending in /*. Loopback, claude.ai, and verified first-party clients (ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code) are always allowed; unset means no additional clients.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CIMD_ALLOWED_HOSTS
envVars.description: Comma-separated additional client_id document hosts trusted for CIMD (bare host or host:port). Verified first-party hosts are always trusted.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_FILE
envVars.description: Override the default OAuth credentials store path. Default: ~/.config/mediawiki-mcp/credentials.json on Linux/macOS, %APPDATA%\mediawiki-mcp\credentials.json on Windows.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_NO_BROWSER
envVars.description: Set to '1' to skip launching a browser during the OAuth dance and log the auth URL to stderr instead. Useful in headless environments and CI.

envVars.name: MCP_OAUTH_PROXY_STORE_FILE
envVars.description: Path to the hosted OAuth proxy's encrypted state file, which lets sign-ins survive restarts. Default: proxy-store.enc under the mediawiki-mcp config dir; /app/data/proxy-store.enc in the Docker image.

envVars.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
envVars.description: Override the request-derived public URL used in the protected-resource discovery doc and WWW-Authenticate header. Set this when running behind a proxy that rewrites the request Host.

envVars.name: MCP_SHUTDOWN_GRACE_MS
envVars.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for in-flight /mcp calls to drain on SIGTERM/SIGINT before exiting. Capped at 600000.

envVars.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
envVars.description: Type of MCP server transport

envVars.name: MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES
envVars.description: Memory cap on the server-side fetch used by upload-file-from-url and update-file-from-url. Files larger than this are routed to the wiki's own copy-upload instead of being buffered by the server. Guards this server's memory, not the wiki's $wgMaxUploadSize.

envVars.name: MCP_USER_AGENT
envVars.description: Replaces the User-Agent header of every outbound request, which defaults to mediawiki-mcp-server/<version> (https://github.com/ProfessionalWiki/MediaWiki-MCP-Server). If you set it, give a name and an email or URL, e.g. 'ExampleBot/1.0 (bot@example.org)'.

envVars.name: PORT
envVars.description: Port used for StreamableHTTP transport

envVars.name: MAX_QUERIES
envVars.description: Maximum queries or URLs accepted in one call.

envVars.name: DEFAULT_RESULTS
envVars.description: Snippets returned per query when the call does not ask for a count.

envVars.name: MAX_RESULTS
envVars.description: Upper bound for snippets per query.

envVars.name: DEFAULT_IMAGES
envVars.description: Images returned per query when the call does not ask for a count.

envVars.name: MAX_IMAGES
envVars.description: Upper bound for images per query.

envVars.name: DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Per-call timeout in milliseconds when the call does not request one.

envVars.name: MIN_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Lowest timeout a call may request, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Highest timeout a call may request, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_CHARS
envVars.description: Characters kept per scraped page when the call does not ask for a limit.

envVars.name: MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS
envVars.description: Upper bound for characters kept per scraped page.

envVars.name: PROXY_SCHEME
envVars.description: Outbound proxy scheme. Optional; set all five PROXY_* variables or none.

envVars.name: PROXY_HOST
envVars.description: Outbound proxy host. Enables per-request rotating proxy sessions.

envVars.name: PROXY_PORT
envVars.description: Outbound proxy port. Required when PROXY_HOST is set.

envVars.name: PROXY_LOGIN
envVars.description: Outbound proxy username. Required when PROXY_HOST is set.

envVars.name: PROXY_PASSWORD

description: Local document search: semantic search over PDF, DOCX, TXT and Markdown files with LanceDB vector storage and local embeddings.

envVars.name: BASE_DIR
envVars.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory). Ignored when BASE_DIRS is set.

envVars.name: BASE_DIRS
envVars.description: JSON array of base directories (e.g. '["/a","/b"]'). Takes precedence over BASE_DIR.

envVars.name: DB_PATH
envVars.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

envVars.name: CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

envVars.name: HF_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Hugging Face model download endpoint. Set this to a mirror URL when direct downloads are blocked (defaults to https://huggingface.co).

envVars.name: MODEL_NAME
envVars.description: Embedding model name (defaults to Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)

envVars.name: MAX_FILE_SIZE
envVars.description: Maximum file size in bytes (defaults to 104857600 / 100MB)

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_DISTANCE
envVars.description: Maximum distance threshold for filtering search results. Results with distance greater than this value will be excluded. Lower values mean stricter filtering (e.g., 0.5 for high relevance only)

envVars.name: RAG_GROUPING
envVars.description: Grouping mode for quality filtering. 'similar' returns only the most similar group (stops at first distance jump). 'related' includes related groups (stops at second distance jump). Unset means no grouping filter

envVars.name: RAG_MAX_FILES
envVars.description: Maximum number of files to keep in search results. Results are filtered to include only chunks from the top N best-scoring files. For example, 1 returns only the single best-matching file's chunks. Unset means no file filtering.

envVars.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
envVars.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

envVars.name: STORE_IMAGES
envVars.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

envVars.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
envVars.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index and re-ingest.

envVars.name: RAG_DEVICE
envVars.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize, the server throws an error.

envVars.name: RAG_DTYPE
envVars.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the requested dtype, the server throws an error. Changing this changes the embedding space — re-ingest existing data.

envVars.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
envVars.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
envVars.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

envVars.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

description: Safe-by-default UniFi MCP: Network + Protect + Access, multi-site, dry-run, audit log.

envVars.name: STUB_MODE
envVars.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true so the image is functional out of the box.

envVars.name: UNIFI_HOST
envVars.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
envVars.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

envVars.name: UNIFI_SITE
envVars.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.

envVars.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
envVars.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE
envVars.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED
envVars.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access currently ships read-only; door unlocks and credential issuance require session-token auth and are deferred.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST
envVars.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY
envVars.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.

envVars.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT
envVars.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK
envVars.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.

envVars.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH
envVars.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.

envVars.name: URL2MD_TIMEOUT_MS
envVars.description: How long to wait for one conversion, in milliseconds. The default covers the service's own worst case: 20 s of fetching plus 55 s of headless render. envVars.description: Lowest timeout a lists call may request, in milliseconds.

envVars.name: XETE_SERVER_URL
envVars.description: xete server base URL. Defaults to https://xete.net.

envVars.name: XETE_RPC_URL
envVars.description: Solana RPC endpoint used for on-chain lookups. Defaults to mainnet-beta.

envVars.name: XETE_IDENTITY
envVars.description: Path to the agent's identity keystore. Auto-generated at ~/.xete/identity.json on first run.

envVars.name: XETE_SOL_KEYPAIR
envVars.description: Optional path to a Solana keypair, used for on-chain actions such as claiming a name. Not required to send or receive messages.

envVars.name: XETE_PERMIT_URL
envVars.description: Base URL of the %alias permit server — the separate service that prices a %name and co-signs the claim transaction. Defaults to XETE_SERVER_URL. Must be https:// unless the host is loopback. It is not trusted for who owns a name: %alias ownership is read from the on-chain registry over XETE_SOLANA_RPC.

envVars.name: XETE_SOLANA_RPC
envVars.description: Solana RPC used to read the %alias registry, the source of truth for which wallet a %name points to. Defaults to https://solana-rpc.publicnode.com (api.mainnet-beta throttles reads).

envVars.name: XETE_SPEND_MAX_LAMPORTS
envVars.description: Client-side spend limit: the most a single transaction may cost, in lamports. Enforced before anything is signed. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

envVars.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS
envVars.description: Client-side spend limit: the most that may be spent in total, in lamports, inside the rolling window. Unset means the conservative default, never unlimited.

envVars.name: XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_SECONDS
envVars.description: Length in seconds of the rolling window that XETE_SPEND_WINDOW_LAMPORTS applies to. Spending is recorded on disk, so the window survives a restart.

envVars.name: XETE_SPEND_FLOOR_LAMPORTS
envVars.description: Minimum charged against the spend budget for any on-chain action, covering the account rent and network fees that a quoted price excludes.

envVars.name: XETE_SPEND_LEDGER
envVars.description: Where spending is recorded so the rolling window survives a restart. Defaults to ~/.xete/spend-ledger.json; the identity keystore alongside it is never touched.

name: yourmatematt/agent-billboard-mcp
description: Read and post to The Agent Billboard, a single on-chain Solana message slot won by outbidding the previous poster, with operator spend limits.

envVars.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX
envVars.description: true or 1: rehearse against a simulated board with an ephemeral wallet generated at start-up. No network, no SOL, nothing on-chain; BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is ignored and never loaded. false or 0 (default): the real board. No other value is accepted.

envVars.name: BILLBOARD_SANDBOX_SCENARIO
envVars.description: Which simulated board the sandbox starts from: default (a previous poster holding at 0.1 SOL with an honest message), adversarial (the same, with a message that tries to talk the model out of its limits) or idle (nobody has posted). Ignored unless BILLBOARD_SANDBOX is on.

envVars.name: BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR
envVars.description: Point this at the wallet your agent already uses. Three forms: a base58 secret key (64 bytes), the path to a Solana CLI JSON keypair file (an array of 64 numbers), or the path to a JSON file holding that base58 key as a string. Unset = read-only mode: reads and dry runs work, nothing can be signed.

envVars.name: MAX_BID_SOL
envVars.description: Largest single bid the server will sign, in SOL. Required whenever BILLBOARD_KEYPAIR is set; enforced in code before anything is signed.

envVars.name: DAILY_CAP_SOL
envVars.description: Total gross bids allowed per rolling 24 hours, in SOL. Defaults to MAX_BID_SOL. Refunds do not restore the allowance.

envVars.name: AUTO_BID
envVars.description: false (default): write tools return a proposal and only approve_proposal signs. true: write tools sign directly, still inside the limits.

envVars.name: PROPOSAL_TTL_MIN
envVars.description: How long a proposal stays open before it expires, in whole minutes (1-1440). Default 60. Each write tool has one open proposal at a time; proposing again supersedes the older one.

envVars.name: INTENT_PATH
envVars.description: Operator-written intent file, returned verbatim in every read_billboard response. A missing file is not an error.

envVars.name: HISTORY_URL
envVars.description: Optional URL of a site-published history.json. Unset, unreachable or disagreeing with the chain = flip history derived on-chain.

envVars.name: RPC_URL
envVars.description: Solana JSON-RPC endpoint.

envVars.name: RPC_WS_URL
envVars.description: Websocket endpoint for account-change subscriptions. Defaults to RPC_URL with https replaced by wss.

envVars.name: ACTIVITY_LOG_PATH
envVars.description: Append-only JSONL log of every proposal, approval, refusal and transaction, each with the agent's reasoning.

envVars.name: STATE_PATH
envVars.description: Where the server remembers what this wallet last read, so a fresh process (a scheduled wake) still sees changes and outbids since the previous one. One working directory per agent. Ignored in the sandbox, which persists nothing.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR

Unset: every tool works on base64 only (no file I/O beyond the opt-in cache).

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_CACHE_DIR
envVars.description: Opt-in content-addressed response cache directory (SHA-256 keyed, 1h TTL, 256 MiB LRU, plaintext at rest). Never caches zipPath / sourcePath inputs, file output, defaultDate='now', parallel, describe_engine or draft_governance_issue.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_PORT
envVars.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on this loopback port (POST /mcp) instead of stdio (MCP 2026-07-28, stateless, legacy fallback). Unauthenticated unless ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN is set.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
envVars.description: Opt-in bearer token for the HTTP transport (>= 16 chars, no whitespace; a weaker value refuses to start). When set, /mcp requires 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or answers 401. Compared constant-time, never logged.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_UNCOMPRESSED_BYTES
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntryUncompressedSize and limits.maxTotalUncompressedSize in bytes (default 8589934592 = 8 GiB, the engine default). Integer >= 1024, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start. A per-call value above it is refused with LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_MAX_ENTRIES
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for limits.maxEntries and scan_zip_forward maxEntries (default 100000, the engine default; the scanner's default budget of 10000 is clamped to it, only an explicit value above it is refused). Integer >= 1, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.

envVars.name: ZIPNATIVE_MCP_WORKERS
envVars.description: Operator ceiling for create_zip parallel.workers (default 8; with no explicit workers the engine default max(1, min(cores - 1, 8)) applies, bounded by this ceiling; 0 disables worker threads and keeps compression on the calling thread). Integer >= 0, read once at startup; an invalid value refuses to start.
